bio: This dinky bistro sports a cheerful green front. In the same spirit as the three jovial pals who run the joint, the food is fun-loving and unfettered, depicted by a vol-au-vent garnished with a veal tajine in a striking, yet happy marriage of staples from different cultures. Feel-good, uninhibited recipes that don’t hesitate to delve into the world of street food for inspiration, as the delectable crab bun illustrates. Smiling bouncy service....
